product.name: MidSizedClinic FHIR Server
product.summary: The clinical data backbone for MidSizedClinic, a mid-sized ultrasound imaging center. Stores and retrieves patient records, imaging studies, radiologist reports, and technician worklists via HIPAA-compliant HL7 FHIR R4 REST APIs. Enables clinic operations to manage imaging workflows, integrate with referring providers' EHRs, and migrate legacy patient data without manual re-entry.
product.organization: MidSizedClinic — a dedicated ultrasound imaging center managing 50–100 patient encounters per week, serving primary-care referrals across a regional network.
product.primaryUseCase: Technician books an imaging appointment for a returning patient. System retrieves prior imaging studies and reports from FHIR Server, displays patient history on worklist, captures new ultrasound, radiologist reads and reports via FHIR, clinic sends report to referring provider via secure API.
product.complianceContext: HIPAA-regulated. Patient identifiers and imaging reports are PHI. All access must be authenticated and auditable. Bulk import of legacy patient data requires anonymization or explicit consent logging.

features.name: FHIR R4 REST API — CRUD operations
features.userStory: As a clinic technician, I want to create patient records and store imaging studies via standard REST calls so that our worklist app doesn't require custom database knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: POST to create Patient, ImagingStudy, DiagnosticReport
GET to retrieve single resource or by ID
PUT to update resource (e.g., technician marks study as read)
DELETE for data cleanup (audit-logged for compliance)

features.name: Imaging search — find patients and prior studies
features.userStory: As a technician at check-in, I want to search for a patient by name or MRN and see their prior imaging studies so I can confirm history without digging through the file cabinet.
acceptanceCriteria: Search patients by name (family, given), birthDate, identifier (MRN)
Search ImagingStudy by patient reference, date range, modality (ultrasound, etc.)
Compartment search: GET /Patient/{id}/ImagingStudy returns all prior studies for that patient
Results paginated; sorting by date descending

features.name: Role-based access control
features.userStory: As a compliance officer, I want role-based data actions so that users only access PHI their job requires.
acceptanceCriteria: read, write, delete, export, hardDelete actions defined

features.name: Authentication (OAuth / JWT)
features.userStory: As MidSizedClinic IT, I want OAuth-protected APIs so that only authenticated clients access patient data.

features.name: Bulk export ($export)
features.userStory: As a data analyst, I want bulk export of FHIR resources so that we can feed analytics and reporting pipelines.

features.name: Bulk import ($import)
features.userStory: As clinic operations, I want NDJSON bulk import so that we can migrate legacy patient data into FHIR.

features.name: SMART on FHIR — clinic-to-referrer integration
features.userStory: As clinic IT, I want SMART-on-FHIR so that referrers' EHR apps can launch against our patient data without requiring custom auth setup for each integration.
acceptanceCriteria: AAD proxy or direct OIDC provider support
Scopes map to clinic roles (technician, radiologist, admin)

features.name: SQL Server persistence — on-premise data
features.userStory: As clinic IT, I want FHIR data stored on SQL Server we manage so that we stay compliant with data-residency policy and can audit database access.
acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment guidance for clinic IT

features.name: Search reindex & maintenance
features.userStory: As clinic IT ops, I want reindex operations so that after schema changes, search queries stay fast and accurate without rebuilding the whole database.

requirements.statement: Patient data access must be logged and restricted to authenticated staff with role-based permissions. Technicians see imaging worklist; radiologists can read and report; only admins delete.
requirements.source: docs/Roles.md, docs/Authentication.md, HIPAA minimum necessary standard
requirements.gap: Roles/auth exist in the server; clinic has not mapped production staff personas or enforced them in live apps.

requirements.statement: Clinic must exchange patient data with referring providers' EHRs using standard FHIR R4 APIs, not custom integrations.
requirements.gap: REST API is shipped; no production referrer EHR exchange configured at the clinic.

requirements.statement: Technicians must search patient imaging history in < 1 second. Worklist must load prior studies without manual file lookup.
requirements.gap: Only exercised via sample app so far — not production check-in worklist or proven under clinic load.

requirements.statement: Clinic has 15 years of patient records in legacy system. Must migrate to FHIR without weeks of manual data entry.
requirements.gap: Runbook for handling conditional references and consent logging needed during migration cutover

requirements.statement: Compliance officer must audit who accessed what patient data when, and export study lists for monthly quality reviews.
requirements.source: HIPAA audit trail requirement, clinic QA process
requirements.gap: Export/reindex exist; clinic has no production QA export process or monthly access-review workflow.

requirements.statement: Clinic wants to adopt a SMART app for patient portal access so patients can view their imaging reports. App must launch securely without clinic building auth.
requirements.gap: Patient-facing SMART apps not launched at clinic. Search upstream: SMART patient portal issues on microsoft/fhir-server.

requirements.statement: Production runs on SQL Server infrastructure clinic already operates. Data stays on-premise per compliance policy.
Exchanged patient data must conform to US Core and payer IG profiles for interoperability with insurance and prior-auth systems.
requirements.source: Regulatory requirement for payer exchange, docs/rest/Readme.md
requirements.gap: US Core profile validation not configured at clinic. Check upstream issues for profile/validation work.

requirements.statement: Every access to PHI must be logged with who, what, when for HIPAA compliance audit. Monthly audit reports to compliance officer.
requirements.source: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312(b), clinic audit policy
